name: gitlogue
description: Watch Claude work: a gitlogue-style pane that replays its edits as live typing, reads code with a highlighter, searches, browses, runs commands and commits, beside a phone-style chat.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Color scheme, one of gitlogue's built-in themes.

playback.title: Playback speed
playback.description: How fast the replay plays, as a multiple of gitlogue's typing speed (30 ms a character). The time the replay may fall behind scales with it.

maxLag.title: Max lag
maxLag.description: Seconds the replay may fall behind Claude at 1x (scaled by the playback speed); past it, playback speeds up to catch up.

open.title: Open the pane
open.description: auto opens it when a session starts (in a terminal 144 columns or wider; narrower, /gitlogue opens it); command opens it only with /gitlogue.

chat.title: Chat view
chat.description: on: while the pane is open, the conversation reads as a LINE-style phone chat (your messages in green on the right, Claude's under its mascot on the left, tool rows left to the pane) and Claude writes its replies like chat messages; off: the conversation stays as it is.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the pane and the phone: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, else the system locale.
